svg.title: 9,054 wallets were force-closed on builder-listed markets on 5 Nov, the most of 31 days
svg.desc: Bar chart of wallets force-closed on builder-listed (HIP-3) markets on each of 31 days. 5 Nov: 9,054, the highest. Median of the 30 days before: 1,755. The same numbers are in the table below.
svg.text: markets on 5 Nov, the most of 31 days
Wallets force-closed each UTC day on builder-listed (HIP-3) markets, 6 Oct to 5 Nov 2026. 5
Nov in orange; dashed line: median of the 30 days before. A wallet is an address, not a
